statusDetail: Cloudflare presented an interactive “Verify you are human” security challenge instead of the origin site. Raw CDP navigation was attempted at desktop and 360×800 mobile viewports, but the challenge prevented representative route discovery and origin-page evidence collection.

page.notes: The origin application was not observable. Every browser navigation ended at a Cloudflare managed challenge with robots noindex,nofollow.

artifacts.caption: Desktop rendering of the Cloudflare human-verification challenge.
Mobile rendering showing the full Cloudflare “Verify you are human” gate.
Rendered DOM and CSS of the intermediary Cloudflare challenge, not the origin site.
Mobile layout metrics for the challenge page only (360 px content width, no overflow, CLS 0.0035).
Recon probe proving the loaded title, text, links, noindex policy, and h1 belong to the Cloudflare challenge.
Pinned Modern Web Guidance search performed before judgement.
Pinned guidance retrieved for accessibility, privacy, forms, security, and error announcement.
Atomic 58-check coverage manifest from the pinned principles catalog.
